questions.Description:
a) Install Windows Server. Create snapshots and restore to already created snapshot.
b) Create firewall Group Policy Objects in Windows server to block the specific port for incoming and outgoing traffic.

a) Install Windows Server in Oracle Virtual Box. Configure the network adapter and enable sharing the resources (folders, USB devices, clipboard) between host computer and guest computer. Create snapshots and restore to already created snapshot using Virtual Box.
b) Configure DHCP feature in Windows server and verify that the client computer receives IP address from the list of IP addresses configured in the DHCP server.

a) Configure roles/features of Active Directory services, DNS in the Windows server. Connect multiple client computers to the server.
b) Configure DHCP feature in Windows server. Reserve specific IP address to a client computer. Verify that the client computer is assigned with the reserved IP address.

a) Configure roles/features of Active Directory services, DNS in the Windows server. Create multiple user accounts, groups. Verify that the user accounts can be logged in all the client computers.
b) Configure FTP server in Windows server and verify that the files can be retrieved from the server to the client computer.

a) Create Group Policy Objects in Windows Server to set a wall paper for all the user accounts.
b) Create automatic task in windows and demonstrate the task is executed in a timely manner. [Hint: Using Windows Task Scheduler]
